text:
Sara: Quick sync — Q2 roadmap decision: do we land customer-managed networking v1 (static peering + egress IP preserve) in the 'minimal pack' or push to v1.1? Customers pushing for deterministic IPs for compliance. Thoughts? :eyes:

Matt: +1 ship minimal pack w/ egress IP preserve in constrained form. We should avoid full BGP e2e for v1.

Julia: Agree. Need clear launch criteria: 1) IP preservation docs 2) automated handoff checklist 3) 2 pilot customers + perf sign-off.

Noah: Ops concerns — we need operator-side tooling for relays. If we ship minimal, we must include fallback to relay mode. Also need upgrade path: 'in-place' vs 'reinstall'.

Elaine: Customer asks for upgrade with zero downtime. Can we define a rollback window and staged canary?

ops-bot: Note from last pilot: TCP stickiness flapped under NAT. Logs excerpt: ```tcp_retry=3
net/e2e: timeout 120s```

Sara: Proposed MVP scope = static peering + egress IP pin + handoff doc + installer flag `--preserve-egress-ip`. No BGP, no tenant-burst changes. Launch criteria: checklist + 2 pilots + runbook tests pass.

Matt: Suggest adding small config snippet for `--preserve-egress-ip`:
```yaml
installer:
  preserve_egress_ip: true
  mode: static_peering
```

Noah: +1. Also add a migration note: 'operator must drain traffic, apply config, validate IPs, undrain' — include in runbook.

Julia: :thumbsup: I'll own runbook and docs. ETA EOD Thurs for draft.

Elaine: I'll coordinate two pilot customers next week and loop in netops. Will ping @Sara if blockers.

Sara: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap ticket (RF: RD-2487) and set a 30m planning slot tomorrow 9:30am. :calendar:
